items.reason: Verifier replies produce timestamped reports under the set's verify directory.
Each final verdict writes one report; filename collisions preserve earlier reports.
The reply contract keeps VERDICT first, and the following prose becomes the report body.
Parsing behavior is unchanged; malformed text and absent-output explanations are preserved.
Report creation covers PASS, FIXABLE, and NEEDS-HUMAN.
PASS findings must state what was checked and why each criterion is met.
Cache reads do not call the report writer.
Invalidation deletes cached verdicts and leaves report files intact.
Previous reports do not enter Verifier prompts; human note handling is unchanged.
Human acceptance writes a report without invoking an agent.
The human report includes the rationale and the overridden verdict.
The header and body identify human authorship.
Human reports use the shared directory, timestamp format, header machinery, and latest-report reader.
The gate preamble shows the latest report path and recorded commit without its body.
The paging entry opens the report and returns to the gate.
CLI and dashboard detail views show the Verify report pointer.
Verify reports rank above Refine reports in the artifact list.
Agent prompts gain no report pointer; golden changes affect only the Verifier response contract.
Missing reports produce no Verify section, preamble, paging entry, or artifact.
Badge and status derivation remain unchanged and do not use report age.
Status rows retain one-line findings but gain no adjacent report pointer; pointers appear only in detail views.
Both passes share rendering, filing, timestamp scanning, and document-header reading.
Refine retains its report format, directory, timestamps, and displayed pointer text.
Refine prompt goldens are unchanged.

scores.rationale: Clear shared machinery and useful tests; status-row pointers are missing, and fallback report counts lack a direct test.
